chunk-001:c004.proposition: Introducing indeterminacy into deliberation does not provide desert-grounding control because the agent still cannot settle which of the supported outcomes occurs.

orphanFallback.rationale: The replay argument independently shows that strategically placed indeterminacy yields an uncontrolled distribution of outcomes rather than the control required for desert.

chunk-001:c005.proposition: Because who agents are and what they do ultimately result from factors beyond their control, basic-desert responsibility is absent under either determinism or indeterminism.

orphanFallback.rationale: This is an independently stated sourcehood thesis: neither deterministic nor indeterministic causal conditions make agents ultimate controllers of themselves and their actions.

chunk-002:chunk-002-candidate-01.proposition: Free-will skepticism rejects basic-desert responsibility while preserving causal and attributive responsibility and forward-looking moral engagement grounded in reconciliation, safety, and moral formation.

orphanFallback.rationale: The distinction constructively defines the precise responsibility notion being denied and identifies several non-desert forms of responsibility that remain available.

chunk-002:chunk-002-candidate-04.proposition: Coercion and liberty restriction can be justified through self-defense, public safety, proportionality, and least-restrictive means without invoking free will, retribution, or basic desert.

orphanFallback.rationale: The quarantine analogy supplies a standalone public-protection basis for proportionate state coercion and restrictions independent of retributive desert.

chunk-002:chunk-002-candidate-09.proposition: Compatibilist agent control and freedom from intentional external manipulation are distinct, and possessing reasons-responsive control leaves open whether basic-desert responsibility is justified.

orphanFallback.rationale: The distinction independently establishes a sufficiency gap between internal reasons-responsive control and the stronger sourcehood needed to justify basic desert.

chunk-003:c003-03.proposition: A forward-looking public-health model can preserve distinctions among intentional, accidental, and habitually negligent conduct by tracking future danger and the protection each case warrants.

orphanFallback.rationale: The contrasting homicide cases independently demonstrate how intent, character, causal involvement, and prospective risk support differentiated protective responses without desert.

chunk-003:c003-06.proposition: Determinism and free-will skepticism preserve rational deliberation, persuasion, belief revision, and reasons-responsive action because reasons can remain causally effective.

orphanFallback.rationale: The causal efficacy of deliberation and belief change independently establishes practical reasons-responsive agency without claiming that this capacity supplies basic-desert freedom.

chunk-004:chunk004-c02.proposition: Because responsibility practices are socially evolved and historically changeable, society can further reform them by relinquishing harmful notions of just desert and retribution.

orphanFallback.rationale: The historical malleability of responsibility practices provides an independent constructive basis for further reform away from desert and retribution.

chunk-004:chunk004-c06.proposition: If backward-looking desert performs genuine justificatory work in a punishment theory, that theory is mixed rather than purely consequentialist; if desert performs none, it should be removed.

orphanFallback.rationale: The dilemma independently requires any defender of desert to identify its distinct justificatory contribution beyond the work already performed by forward-looking considerations.

chunk-005:chunk-005-candidate-002.proposition: Desert-dependent moral anger can be replaced by attitudes such as disappointment or sorrow while retaining, and potentially improving, the practical work of interpersonal responsibility practices.

orphanFallback.rationale: The proposed replacement attitudes constitute a standalone reform model that preserves interpersonal regulation without presupposing basic desert.
